comparison.objective: Position a food shield with a specified overhang; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object placement versus recessed-tool engagement, collar adjustment, force-limited locking, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Shield front lip 18–30 cm past food versus two compliant carriage stops without bottoming, rebound, overload, or setting drift. Other rubric details are absent.
comparison.reason: Spatial placement does not test damper adjustment or dynamic-response commissioning.
